title: On the Classification of blow-up solutions of a singular Liouville equation on the disk
summary: We study the blow-up behavior of solutions to the singular Liouville equation \[ Δ\tilde u+λe^{\tilde u}=4παδ_0 \quad\text{in }B,\quad \tilde u=0 \quad\text{on }\partial B, \] where $α>0$, $λ>0$ and $B\subset\mathbb R^2$ is the unit disk. Our main results give a complete classification of all blow-up solutions and determine the exact number of solutions to the above equation.
